purpose: Read-only design review for narrowly allowlisted Finland INSPIRE CP GML WFS reader support. No source, catalog, registry or city configuration was changed and no polygon was added.

source.name: National Land Survey of Finland INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels WFS 2.0

describeFeatureType.finding: The WFS wrapper imports the external INSPIRE CP XSD.

identifierFields.localId: string; unique within the INSPIRE namespace
identifierFields.versionId: optional version identifier, excluded from the unique ID

source.nativeAxisOrder: Easting, Northing (E,N); the public Finland CRS table identifies EPSG:3067 as TM35FIN(E,N). The stored first vertex [385349.096, 6672293.508] is Easting then Northing and the fresh ResourceID response reproduces the sample coordinate sequence exactly.
source.codeReadiness: backend/parcels/gml-parcel-reader.js currently has no proj4 definition for EPSG:3067; add a fixed, authority-checked EPSG:3067 definition before enabling coordinate transformation.

observedFeatureStructure.geometryTypeLimit: The CadastralParcel XSD declares generic gml:GeometryPropertyType, so the schema does not promise polygon-only responses. The bounded observed component is a Polygon. Keep the allowlist strictly polygonal and fail closed for points, lines, curves, TINs, unsupported GML ring encodings, and any geometry tags outside the existing parser whitelist; do not linearize or repair geometry.

existingSamples.nationalCadastralReference: 09100499010000 is shared by two distinct sample components; never use it alone as a canonical key or merge rule.

unsupportedIdentityPropertyFilters.finding: Server reports nested attribute path not found, for both known and synthetic IDs. Do not use these filters or infer absence from them.

unsupportedProjection.finding: Schema-correct GET and POST property projection requests fail with HTTP 400. Omit the propertyName parameter; parse only whitelisted identity and polygon geometry fields, discard all other response values in memory.

storedQuery.finding: Prior HTTP 404 for known and synthetic IDs is inconclusive; do not use it or infer absence.

proposedDescriptor.nativeIdPattern: ^[0-9]+$ (observed component ID pattern; schema type remains string and any widening requires new evidence)

schema.identityStrategy: INSPIRE base Identifier subtree + gml:identifier + gml:id cross-check
schema.localIdPattern: ^[0-9]+$ (strict observed-profile pattern, not an INSPIRE XSD restriction)

wfsProfile.bboxMode: standard WFS KVP BBOX in EPSG:3067 Easting,Northing order
wfsProfile.idQueryMode: WFS 2 RESOURCEID (KVP GET); FES 2 ResourceId POST was independently demonstrated

canonicalOutput.featureId: canonical INSPIRE URI formed as expectedNamespace + localId; must equal gml:identifier text

properties.sourceParcelId: localId string used internally to map RESOURCEID and absence results
properties.sourceProperties: only localId may be retained; no national reference or unrelated INSPIRE fields

allowlistedProfileExtensions.state: Design only. Existing `canonicalParcelFeature` can generate the URI through descriptor.idPrefix + localId; the current fixed GML parser needs path-aware identity capture and explicit gml:identifier cross-check. No local-code proof of sourceProperty URI encoding is implied.

minimalImplementationPlan.change: Add one exact FINLAND_CP_GML_SCHEMA to CUSTOM_SCHEMAS. Extend the allowlisted parser path only to capture base:localId/base:namespace under cp:inspireId/base:Identifier, direct gml:identifier text/codeSpace and gml:id; enforce the four identity equalities and output only localId plus parsed geometry. Register an authority-verified EPSG:3067 proj4 definition; axis order is E,N.

Add one exact FI profile. Use internal resourceIdPrefix FI_CP_CADASTRALPARCEL_, canonical descriptor idPrefix as the INSPIRE namespace URI, omit propertyName, and add a bounded KVP BBOX route for queryBounds. Do not use the failing FES nested-ID PropertyIsEqualTo path or unverified FES Intersects path.

No change expected: canonicalParcelFeature derives `feature.id` and `parcelId` from descriptor.idPrefix + localId, which yields the gml:identifier URI. Verify this with a contract test; sourceParcelId remains the localId locator component.

Do not edit during this design review. If root approves implementation and subsequent qualification, one Finland city provider record can use the fixed profile; no global country or registry changes are required for the profile code itself.

minimalPlannedTests: Validate exact profile and reject descriptor mutations: endpoint, feature QName, response CRS, ID prefix, geometry field or outFields.
Parse an inline metadata-only fixture matching actual cp:CadastralParcel GML structure; assert localId/namespace/gml:identifier/gml:id cross-checks and canonical output URI.
Reject missing, duplicate or mismatched localId, namespace, gml:identifier, codeSpace and gml:id; reject IDs outside the observed numeric suffix shape.
Check EPSG:3067 definition exists, GML EPSG:3067 E,N coordinates transform into valid WGS84 polygon coordinates, and round-trip error is bounded; do not swap axes.
Accept the observed Polygon and supported polygonal MultiSurface/PolygonPatch forms; reject Point, LineString, Curve/MultiCurve, TIN and unsupported GML pos/coordinates/Ring encodings.

Mock queryIds for known and synthetic canonical URI IDs: request uppercase RESOURCEID values, enforce hit/data count agreement, cross-check returned gml:id, return URI feature ID, and report absent only for stable successful zero counts.
Mock queryBounds with BBOX KVP: assert EPSG:3067 E,N order, no propertyName parameter, stable hits before/after, correct startIndex/count paging, and polygon clipping in WGS84.
Verify parser and canonical output never retain nationalCadastralReference, label, address/holder/owner or any other unconfigured property despite unprojected server responses.

items: Actual hit counts for known and synthetic ResourceIDs and the bounded Helsinki BBOX are supported.
The pre-hit/data-page/post-hit sequence has not been run end-to-end against this adapter; test it before relying on exact absence or count stability.
BBOX startIndex offset page (for example startIndex=3) and post-query count stability have not been verified live.
FES Intersects was not demonstrated for cp:geometry; use the proven BBOX KVP route, then validate the complete 13-cell runtime sample separately.
The XSD geometry property is generic GeometryPropertyType; only polygonal encodings are in scope, and no citywide unsupported-geometry prevalence is known.
No geometry has been retained beyond the existing three Finland sample polygons.
The observed numeric localId pattern is sample evidence, while the INSPIRE schema declares localId as string; retain a fail-closed profile pattern until wider ID-shape evidence is collected.
